best_quotes: I told you I was going to kill you
legendary_moment: As Anastrasya leaned in for the killing bite, Roger pulled her onto his blade. They both collapsed, and the room went quiet.
funniest_moment: Zadkiel used the question Korino won from a card hustler to ask whether his armour had a hidden feature. It apparently didn't, and Hrulek joked that Zadkiel had scammed the party too.
signature_move: Put himself between the party and the threat, usually with a blade already drawn.
worst_decision: Roger dove at Anastrasya, missed both shots, and went down to Chill Touch within biting distance.
running_jokes: Roger looking like Danny DeVito in his circus outfit
Zadkiel yelling at Azza not to eat people
award: Most Likely to Make His Last Words a Promise Kept
nat20_moments: Session 54: Danny and Fraser both rolled natural 20s to draw the circus crowd in and fill the seats.

best_quotes: Image of my master, he would never have me join Vampyr and join this filth
We interact with a scammer, and Zadkiel ends up scamming us. Didn't see that coming
legendary_moment: Seconds after Korino got him back on his feet, Hrulek landed back-to-back critical hits on a courtier, dropped him from full health, and burned an H into him.
funniest_moment: Hrulek summoned Trevor, a war camel, after the party finished fighting a group of trees.
signature_move: Charge into melee and spend a smite when the hit lands.
worst_decision: Hrulek tried to use a potion he'd stolen from Strahd at the start of a fight. It was a mimic.
running_jokes: Hrulek turning into ash and getting back up again
award: Most Likely to Smite First and Check the Potion Label Later
nat20_moments: Session 54: Fraser and Danny both rolled natural 20s to fill the circus seats.
Session 57: Hrulek rolled two natural 20s while the amber golem followed with two natural 1s.

best_quotes: I can eat people if they're dead? Not the hearts though
Look on the bright side, One consort dead, we did it together. May have made an enemy, but still, 1 on the score board.
No one deserves what has happened to my soul
legendary_moment: During Anastrasya's fight, Azza spotted her through her invisibility, rescued Ezmerelda from the enchanted dance, and got Hrulek back up with Healing Word.
funniest_moment: Azza told the party about a brewery raid that ended with flying wood, splinters in someone's backside, and nearby houses and fields on fire. He described it as controlled demolition.
signature_move: Use cleric magic to pull the party out of trouble, then make a remark that starts another argument.
worst_decision: Azza nearly died trying to steal greater healing potions while Fluffy was eating.
running_jokes: Azza's rules about which parts of a corpse are edible
Azza and Zadkiel arguing over whether eating a dead dwarf counts
award: Most Likely to Save Your Life and Insult You in the Same Round
nat20_moments: Session 69: Azza rolled a natural 20 to spot a bloodstained Rahadin, who waved back and readied his bow.

best_quotes: me hope you can say same, Strahd
I WISH to restore my party to their state from this dawn!
You shall if you serve me!
legendary_moment: Korino's wish brought him before Nhazul. He pledged his soul after death, and the party watched Hrulek reform from ash.
funniest_moment: Gurn wondered why one of his sling stones was getting bigger. It hatched into Tuulikki.
signature_move: Use a spell to get someone out of immediate danger, even when it costs him something.
worst_decision: Gurn killed Ella at Old Bonegrinder as part of his bargain with DealsInLuck.
running_jokes: Jefferson turning Korino's armour into a conversation with an accountant
award: Most Likely to Make a Wish the Gods Actually Hear
nat20_moments: Session 34: Korino rolled a natural 20 to get back up, then crawled to the fane beneath Baba Yaga and saved it.
Session 39: Korino rolled a natural 20 while sapping the Abbot's strength.

best_quotes: If you save this Unicorn, maybe Lathander would notice you
legendary_moment: Vryin offered the party tea at the Amber Temple and warned them that its visions could exploit their insecurities.
funniest_moment: Vryin reckoned the party would kill Strahd before anyone managed to teach Azza manners.
signature_move: Give a practical warning about what was behind the next door.
award: Most Likely to Put the Kettle On in the Amber Temple
